unattached_marks.description: Ink arrow pointing left, drawn at the right side of the page near the gutter on the same ruled line as b002. It probably links the incipit to an entry on another page, possibly the facing fol. 145.
Small dark speck or ink blot in the lower left part of the page. It is not text.
Small tear or stitching mark at the gutter. It is not text.

boundary_notes: A strip of the facing page (fol. 145) is visible to the right of the gutter, beyond x≈3180. It shows ticks and shelfmark fragments such as 'c.', 'd.' and 'e.'. These are facing-page fragments and are excluded from the target inventory.
Faint mirrored show-through of the text on the reverse side (fol. 144) is visible across the ruled lines. It is not writing on this page and has not been inventoried.
Attachment of b002 is ambiguous. It could continue an entry on fol. 144 or attach to an entry on fol. 145 via the arrow, so it is kept as an independent unattached incipit block.
uncertainties: The exact reading of the opening word ('Begins'/'Begin') and of the final word(s) of b002 is uncertain because the hand is cursive and the line trails off.
The target of the arrow is not certain.

annotations: Ink folio number in the top left corner. The 'b' is written raised, as a superscript, after '144'.

relationships.evidence: Fol. 145 has a left-pointing arrow in its outer margin at roughly the same height as this line and the arrow on this page. This suggests the incipit was written here for that entry.
The note could alternatively relate to an entry on fol. 144, the recto of this leaf. No direct link is visible.

uncertainties: The opening word may be 'Begin' or 'Begins'; no final 's' is clearly visible.

block_disposition.explanation: Independent incipit note whose attachment is ambiguous.
Arrow on the same line as the incipit, linking it probably to the facing page.

page_annotations: Apart from the folio number and the single incipit line with its arrow, the ruled page is blank after image review.
Faint mirrored show-through from fol. 144 is visible across the page and is not transcribed.
A small blot at about [680,3875] and a small gutter tear or stitching mark at about [3130,2650] are not text.
A strip of facing fol. 145 is visible right of the gutter, showing ticks and the shelfmark letters c., d. and e. These belong to the facing page and are excluded.
unresolved_relationships: It is unconfirmed whether the incipit in r002 belongs to fol. 145 'c. 390 (11) Puruṣadānavidhi' (probable) or to an entry on fol. 144.

coverage.finding: The folio number '144' with a raised 'b' is visible in ink at the top left. It is correctly recorded.

The single ink line on the first ruled line is represented. The reading of the final word is not secure. The native tile shows a letter form like 'l..tvā' followed by a possible query mark, then two short dashes. This does not support 'likhet' as a reading. The opening word 'Begin'/'Begins' remains uncertain.
A left-pointing ink arrow lies at about x 2989–3152, y about 645, on the same ruled line as b002. Attaching it to r002 as linking evidence is reasonable. Its target is not confirmed.
